Messages.Author: Nathanael P Shelley
Messages.Body:
i've got a couple of rulings questions for all of you out there 'in the
know'. let me know what you think:

- Chantry: can you free more than one vampire from torpor per master
phase?

- Same turn actions/Force of will:
As i understand it, no vampire may take the same action more than
once per turn. If this is (still) correct, does that mean you
cannot bleed, and then play Force of Will to bleed again?

- Blood Hunt Vote:
After a vampire commits diablerie and the blood hunt vote is
called, only votes on the table may be used; does this mean
that the edge can be burned for a vote?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Nathanael P Shelley <nshe...@acsu.buffalo.edu> wrote:
> - Chantry: can you free more than one vampire from torpor per master
> phase?

No. "During phase X, do Y" limits Y to once per phase X.
[LSJ 25-JUN-1997]

> - Same turn actions/Force of will:
> As i understand it, no vampire may take the same action
more than
> once per turn. If this is (still) correct, does that mean
you
> cannot bleed, and then play Force of Will to bleed again?

Under the DCI tournament rules, the "No Repeat Action" rule applies,
correct. If you are using that rule, then a given minion cannot
use Force of Will to bleed a second time in the same turn, correct.

> - Blood Hunt Vote:
> After a vampire commits diablerie and the blood hunt vote
is
> called, only votes on the table may be used; does this mean
> that the edge can be burned for a vote?

Bloodhunts do not restrict voting to "table votes".
The restriction is only against reaction cards and action modifiers,
since there is no action to modify or react to.
The Edge (and political action cards) can be burned for votes as
normal. [6.5.6]
